title: The element fixture defines every family and its button, tabs and tooltip respond to the keyboard
intent: On /elements.html the built bundle defines every ult-* tag, each catalogue family appears in the section matching the mode, and a button activates, Tabs select with the arrow keys and a Tooltip opens on focus and closes on Escape, painted in that section's tokens.
preconditions: The page is the built docs' /elements.html, loading /elements/ultima.js and /tokens.css; it sets no self-hosted face.
The page has a Dark and a Light section, each forcing its mode with data-theme; a cell works in the section that matches its mode and checks errors across the whole page.

steps.action: Load /elements.html and wait for every ult-* tag it uses to be defined.
steps.expect: Every catalogue element family appears in the mode's section, which paints that mode's surface.

steps.action: Focus the solid Save button and press Enter, then Space.
steps.expect: Each key activates it once; it shows the focus ring and paints the accent fill with its contrast text.

steps.action: Focus the Overview tab in Report views and press ArrowRight, then ArrowRight again.
steps.expect: Findings is selected with its panel shown, then the disabled Archive tab is skipped and Overview is selected again.

steps.action: Tab to the Copy button with the Copied to clipboard tooltip, then press Escape.
steps.expect: The tooltip opens on focus on the raised surface, and Escape closes it with focus still on the button.
